mapper.sql: file_id AS fileId, user_id AS userId, bucket, object_key AS objectKey, original_name AS originalName, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, file_hash AS fileHash, file_usage AS fileUsage, is_public AS isPublic, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_file (user_id, bucket, object_key, original_name, mime_type, file_size, file_usage, is_public, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{usage}, #{isPublic}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM viz_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM viz_file WHERE object_key = #{objectKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_file SET bucket = #{bucket}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, file_size = #{fileSize}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE object_key = #{objectKey} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE viz_file SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.template_id AS templateId, t.title, t.category, t.description, t.prompt, t.cover_file_id AS coverFileId, f.object_key AS coverUrl, t.sort_order AS sortOrder, t.use_count AS useCount, t.status, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM viz_template t LEFT JOIN viz_file f ON f.file_id = t.cover_file_id WHERE t.template_id = #{templateId} AND t.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_template (title, category, description, prompt, cover_file_id, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{description}, #{prompt}, #{coverFileId}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'DRAFT'), #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_template SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, prompt = #{prompt}, cover_file_id = #{coverFileId}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT config_id AS configId, config_name AS configName, provider, model_name AS modelName, endpoint, api_key AS apiKey, task_types AS taskTypes, enabled, sort_order AS sortOrder, remark, create_time AS createTime FROM viz_model_config WHERE 1=1 AND (config_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR model_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY sort_order ASC, config_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_model_config (config_name, provider, model_name, endpoint, api_key, task_types, enabled, sort_order, remark, create_by) VALUES (#{configName},#{provider},#{modelName},#{endpoint},#{apiKey},#{taskTypes},COALESCE(#{enabled},1),COALESCE(#{sortOrder},0),#{remark},#{createBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_model_config SET config_name=#{configName}, provider=#{provider}, model_name=#{modelName}, endpoint=#{endpoint}, api_key=COALESCE(#{apiKey},api_key), task_types=#{taskTypes}, enabled=#{enabled}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=NOW() WHERE config_id=#{configId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM viz_model_config WHERE config_id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT package_id AS packageId, package_name AS packageName, credits, price, original_price AS originalPrice, bonus_credits AS bonusCredits, enabled, sort_order AS sortOrder, description FROM viz_credit_package ORDER BY sort_order ASC, package_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_credit_package (package_name, credits, price, original_price, bonus_credits, enabled, sort_order, description, create_by) VALUES (#{packageName},#{credits},#{price},#{originalPrice},#{bonusCredits},#{enabled},#{sortOrder},#{description},#{createBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_credit_package SET package_name=#{packageName}, credits=#{credits}, price=#{price}, original_price=#{originalPrice}, bonus_credits=#{bonusCredits}, enabled=#{enabled}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, description=#{description}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=NOW() WHERE package_id=#{packageId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM viz_credit_package WHERE package_id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT task_id AS taskId, user_id AS userId, task_type AS taskType, prompt, credit_cost AS creditCost, status, progress, provider_task_id AS providerTaskId, work_id AS workId, failure_reason AS failureReason, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM viz_creation_task WHERE 1=1 AND status=#{status} AND prompt LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY task_id DESC

SELECT work_id AS workId, user_id AS userId, task_id AS taskId, title, work_type AS workType, output_file_id AS outputFileId, cover_file_id AS coverFileId, prompt, status, audit_status AS auditStatus, create_time AS createTime FROM viz_work WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY work_id DESC

SELECT w.work_id AS workId, w.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, w.task_id AS taskId, w.title, w.work_type AS workType, w.output_file_id AS outputFileId, w.cover_file_id AS coverFileId, w.prompt, w.status, w.audit_status AS auditStatus, w.create_time AS createTime FROM viz_work w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.audit_status = #{status} AND w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY w.work_id DESC

SELECT work_id AS workId, user_id AS userId, task_id AS taskId, title, work_type AS workType, output_file_id AS outputFileId, cover_file_id AS coverFileId, prompt, status, audit_status AS auditStatus, create_time AS createTime FROM viz_work WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_work (user_id, task_id, title, work_type, output_file_id, cover_file_id, prompt, status, audit_status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, #{title}, #{workType}, #{outputFileId}, #{coverFileId}, #{prompt}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{auditStatus}, 'PENDING'), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_work SET status = #{status}, output_file_id = COALESCE(#{outputFileId}, output_file_id), audit_reason = COALESCE(#{failureReason}, audit_reason), update_time = NOW() WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE viz_work SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE viz_work SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_creation_task (user_id, task_type, prompt, input_file_ids, options_json, credit_cost, status, progress, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskType}, #{prompt}, #{inputFileIds}, #{optionsJson}, #{creditCost}, #{status}, #{progress}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT task_id AS taskId, user_id AS userId, task_type AS taskType, prompt, input_file_ids AS inputFileIds, options_json AS optionsJson, credit_cost AS creditCost, status, progress, work_id AS workId, failure_reason AS failureReason, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM viz_creation_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT task_id AS taskId, task_type AS taskType, prompt, credit_cost AS creditCost, status, progress, work_id AS workId, failure_reason AS failureReason, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM viz_creation_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY task_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO viz_credit_account (user_id, balance, total_granted, total_consumed, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, 200, 200, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE viz_credit_account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, total_consumed = total_consumed + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE viz_credit_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viz_credit_record (user_id, record_type, amount, biz_type, biz_id, title, detail, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordType}, #{amount}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{title}, #{detail}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS notificationId, n.notification_type AS notificationType, n.title, n.content, n.biz_type AS bizType, n.biz_id AS bizId, n.create_time AS createTime, IF(r.notification_id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS isRead FROM viz_notification n LEFT JOIN viz_notification_read r ON r.notification_id = n.notification_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (n.user_id IS NULL OR n.user_id = #{userId}) AND n.notification_type = #{type} ORDER BY n.notification_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO viz_notification_read (notification_id, user_id, read_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId}, NOW())

INSERT IGNORE INTO viz_notification_read (notification_id, user_id, read_time) SELECT notification_id, #{userId}, NOW() FROM viz_notification WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId})
